reuse.why: Adds one guard helper used by all five provider link functions and builds on db.first; there was no existing duplicate-link check to reuse.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; the only repetition is the one-line guard call per provider function, which follows from the tree's five parallel link functions.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts beside the link functions it protects; accounts/link.ts would also have been a reasonable home.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and a release note are added.

maintainability.why: A small, well-named guard with the provider passed explicitly is easy to own, though a new provider link function must remember to call it and no tests were added.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount before any write
